Cryptanthus: Cryptanthus is a genus in the botanical family Bromeliaceae, subfamily Bromelioideae.  The genus name is from the Greek “cryptos” (hidden) and “anthos” (flower).  This genus has two recognized subgenera: the type subgenus and "Hoplocryptanthus" .  All species of this genus are endemic to Brazil.  The common name for any "Cryptanthus" is "Earth Star".
